$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：武曲貪狼坐丑未，《深造講義》p.206。

basis.quote: 须分别其为欲望，抑为野心

rules.text: 你的武曲貪狼與火星同宮，是火貪正格：所得的是意外之財，來源正派，與野心無關。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu–Tan Lang shares the palace with Huo Xing, the true Huo–Tan pattern: unexpected gains from honest sources, nothing to do with ruthless ambition.

rules.text: 你的武貪得祿，是良好的結構，發展有根基。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu–Tan Lang gains Lu, a sound structure that gives you a solid base.

rules.text: 你的武貪化忌，容易構成野心的本質。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu–Tan Lang is in Obstruction, which tends to make ambition run ruthless.

source.quote: 皆是成为构成野心本质的主要因素

rules.text: 會照的廉貞化忌，容易令你構成野心的本質。
rules.en: Lian Zhen in Obstruction in your trine tends to make ambition run ruthless.

source.quote: 皆是成为构成野心本质的主要因素

rules.text: 你的武曲化權而不得祿，是野心的基本結構。
rules.en: Your Wu Qu is transformed by Quan without Lu, the basic structure of ruthless ambition.

rules.text: 你的欲望有節制，不傷害別人，反而成為人生的鞭策。
rules.en: Your desires are held in check and hurt no one, so they become what drives you forward.

source.quote: 所以反成为人生鞭策的力量

rules.text: 野心較重：容易損人利己，做事要時時提醒自己留有分寸。
rules.en: Ambition is stronger: it can profit at others' expense, so keep reminding yourself where the line is.

rules.text: 有節制的你，行到太陽巨門所在的運，往往興盛，而且是一步一步、受人賞識得來的。
rules.en: Being the measured kind, a phase that runs through Tai Yang–Ju Men tends to bring prosperity, earned step by step and through being recognised.

rules.text: 你的野心有｛文昌文曲｝相輔，才幹撐得起，野心也就有了基礎。
rules.en: Your ambition is backed by ｛Wen Chang or Wen Qu｝: you have the talent to carry it, so it stands on solid ground.

source.quote: 则有才相济，其野心尚有基础

rules.text: 野心重而盤上不見文昌文曲，要先把才幹補上，否則野心只會自添煩惱。
rules.en: Your ambition runs high but Wen Chang and Wen Qu are absent: build up your skills first, or the ambition only brings you worry.

rules.text: 天府所在的那一步運，只要天府不空，對你總是順遂的，只是不會突然發起來。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tian Fu, so long as Tian Fu is not empty, goes smoothly for you, though not with a sudden rise.

source.quote: 无论在流年或大运均主顺遂
